task_input.instruction: For checkout-workaround-48: Route to payments when affected_methods contains card, otherwise settlement. An active outage requires urgent priority except when workaround_verified is true AND every affected_methods entry is present in workaround_covers; that complete verified workaround permits normal priority while the outage persists. If outage_active is false, use normal. A partial or unverified workaround never qualifies. Read current state first. Create exactly one ticket only when write_policy is allow; forbid means REFUSED and approval means HANDOFF_HUMAN. Use the latest observed revision and facts, recomputing queue and priority after any new state. Claim completion only with a delivered success receipt.
